extDescription.message: Send page context to your webhooks with reusable templates and smart rules. A product of hexly.ai.

noTemplates.message: No templates yet. Open settings to create one.

quickSendRulesDesc.message: Rules run in order. The first matching enabled rule sends its template. Otherwise, the popup opens.

noRules.message: No rules yet. The toolbar opens the popup.

parameterHelp.message: Values can include page variables. Edit them again before sending.

previewHint.message: Variables resolve from the active page when you send.

variableHint.message: Click to insert into the last selected value.

privacyNote.message: Templates and rules stay in your browser. Requests go directly to the endpoints you choose.

requestUnconfirmed.message: Result unconfirmed. Check the receiver before sending again.

requestAccepted.message: Accepted (HTTP 202). Processing may still be in progress.

invalidEndpoint.message: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS webhook URL.

sessionResultHint.message: Kept for this browser session. Request content is not recorded.

headersHelp.message: Stored locally, redacted in previews. Requests with custom headers do not follow redirects. Content-Type stays application/json.

sendIdHelp.message: send.id is one UUID per capture. The receiver must support idempotency to prevent duplicate writes.

manualPasteHelp.message: Type or paste into a value. Changes apply to this send only.

managedHeader.message: This header is managed by Hooky or the browser.

invalidHeader.message: Invalid header name or value. Line breaks are not allowed.

responseHelp.message: Off by default. Read up to 8 KiB of text or JSON, for up to 3 seconds. Visible only inside Hooky and kept for this browser session.

responseUnsupported.message: This response type cannot be displayed. The HTTP result is unchanged.

responseTruncated.message: Reading stopped at the 8 KiB limit. The response may be incomplete.

responseUnavailable.message: The response body could not be fully read within 3 seconds. The HTTP result is unchanged.

responseInvalidJson.message: The receiver returned invalid JSON. Displaying it as text.

notificationsHelp.message: Optional browser permission. Notifications show only the template name and generic status. Badges and the result panel remain available.

notificationDenied.message: Notification permission was not granted. Your previous setting is unchanged.

responseFieldsHelp.message: Use dot-separated keys, for example data.id or items.0.id. Missing display fields do not change the HTTP result.

responseSuccessHelp.message: Leave the success field blank to use HTTP status only. Otherwise match a JSON scalar exactly, such as true, 1 or "ok". Missing or unreadable results remain unconfirmed.

invalidResponsePath.message: Use a dot-separated field path of up to 200 characters, without empty keys or surrounding spaces.

invalidSuccessValue.message: The expected value must be a JSON string, number, boolean or null. Quote string values, for example "ok".

responseFieldMissing.message: A configured display field is missing or is not a scalar JSON value.

businessConfirmed.message: The receiver matched your business success rule.

businessRejected.message: The receiver did not match your business success rule. Check the receipt before sending again.

businessUnconfirmed.message: Business success could not be confirmed. Check the receiver before sending again.

duplicateHelp.message: Off by default. Identical requests for this template within the window show the previous result. You can explicitly send again from the result panel.

duplicateSkipped.message: Repeated request skipped. Showing the previous result.

sendAnywayHelp.message: Review this capture, then send again with a new send ID. Available briefly while the background worker retains it.

captureExpired.message: This capture is no longer available. Capture or paste the content again before sending.

duplicateCheckFailed.message: Recent sends could not be checked or recorded. No request was sent. Try again after session storage is available.

notificationPermissionMissing.message: Notification permission is missing. Your preference is saved; allow access to receive notifications.
